name: embedded-assets
body: Only the core of the tool is embedded via Go `embed` and served from the binary: reveal.js (pinned to release 6.0.2, MIT) and the unbranded core page shells (deck page, full-page error page, /templates gallery page), plus the minimal `eypres init` seed (see cli-init-minimal-seed). These are core to the tool, not templates or assets. reveal.js is vendored from the release package's `dist/` directory into `internal/assets/reveal/` and committed there together with its `LICENSE`; no `npm install`, no build step. No templates, themes, fonts, logos, starter decks or other media are embedded; the former EY templates, theme, fonts and logos are deleted from the codebase entirely (no in-repo EY library) — every project supplies its own `templates/` (see project-templates). AC: `internal/assets` embeds no templates/, fonts/, logo/, starter/ or theme.css; the repo contains no EY template, theme, font or logo; the core page shells reference no brand asset and style only via the project theme's stylesheet.
